pages.heading: Remote Website and App Testing
pages.summary: Request a free initial website or app test from AshaRatna Tech. Send your public URL on WhatsApp or email and share the user flow you want checked.

contentSections.heading: Test the paths that matter to your users
paragraphs: Remote website and app testing looks at how people move through a product, not only whether individual screens load. AshaRatna Tech can scope checks around the tasks that matter to your audience, such as finding information, navigating between pages, completing a form, or using an account flow.
Testing begins with an agreed set of pages, devices, browsers, and user journeys. A focused scope helps teams understand what was checked and where more coverage may be useful.
bullets: Forms and the feedback users receive after submitting them
Account, enquiry, booking, or purchase flows where applicable

contentSections.heading: Review the mobile and browser experience
paragraphs: A website that works on a desktop can still be difficult to use on a phone. Checks can include layout at common screen sizes, text readability, tap targets, visible content, and whether important actions remain easy to find.
Browser and device differences can also affect how a page behaves. Agreeing on the browsers and devices your customers use helps make testing relevant instead of relying on a generic checklist.

contentSections.heading: Get findings that are easier to act on
paragraphs: A useful testing report describes the issue, how to reproduce it, the expected result, and the observed result. Where available, screenshots and device or browser details can help a developer verify the problem.
Testing can reduce uncertainty before a release, but no test can guarantee that every possible defect has been found. The report should make the tested scope and any remaining gaps clear.

contentSections.heading: How to prepare for a remote test
paragraphs: To discuss a testing request, share the public website or app link, the main actions users need to complete, and the devices or browsers that matter most. You can also describe any known issue or recent change you want reviewed.
If a test requires an account, arrange access through a safe method agreed with the team. Do not send passwords or other sensitive access details in an ordinary email.

faqs.question: What does remote website and app testing cover?
faqs.answer: The scope can include navigation, important user flows, forms, mobile layouts, and browser-specific behavior. The exact checks are agreed before testing begins.

faqs.question: Can you test a website on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. A testing request can focus on mobile screen layouts and the actions customers need to complete on a phone. The devices and browsers should be agreed as part of the scope.

faqs.question: Does testing guarantee a bug-free website or app?
faqs.answer: No. Testing helps find and document issues within an agreed scope, but it cannot guarantee that every defect or device-specific problem has been found.

faqs.question: Can I get a website or app test for free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send a public website or app URL to request one free initial test. Any deeper or ongoing testing can be discussed separately.

pages.description: Request a free initial SEO check from AshaRatna Tech. Send your website URL on WhatsApp or email for feedback on search visibility, metadata, and pages.
pages.heading: SEO Services for Websites and Web Apps
pages.summary: Request a free initial SEO check from AshaRatna Tech. Send your website URL on WhatsApp or email to get initial feedback on search visibility and page setup.

contentSections.heading: Start with crawlability and technical SEO
paragraphs: Search visibility depends on more than adding keywords to a page. Technical SEO checks whether important pages can be found, crawled, and indexed, and whether search engines receive consistent signals about each URL.

A review can cover robots directives, XML sitemaps, canonical URLs, page status codes, mobile basics, and duplicate or missing metadata. The findings help separate issues that block discovery from improvements that can be prioritized over time.

contentSections.heading: Make each page match a clear search intent
paragraphs: On-page SEO helps visitors and search engines understand what a page offers. This can include unique page titles and descriptions, one descriptive main heading, useful subheadings, natural wording, and relevant internal links.

For a service business, a page should explain who the service is for, what work may be included, and how to ask for more information. Clear copy is more useful than repeating the same keyword without answering a real question.
bullets: Review titles, descriptions, headings, and image text
Improve internal links between related service pages
Clarify page content around the questions potential customers ask

contentSections.heading: Build useful coverage for websites and web apps
paragraphs: A homepage alone may not explain every service clearly. Dedicated pages can help visitors compare relevant offerings and give search engines a more specific page to understand for each topic.

SEO work can be planned around the pages and goals that matter to your business. It should not promise a particular ranking: search results depend on competition, site quality, search engine changes, and signals beyond any one page.

contentSections.heading: Measure progress and choose the next improvement
paragraphs: SEO is an ongoing process. Once analytics and search performance tools are configured, teams can review which pages attract visits, how people arrive, and whether the content supports useful enquiries.

A practical plan prioritizes technical blockers first, then improves important pages and reviews the results. Contact AshaRatna Tech with your website or web app URL and the audience or service you want to reach.

faqs.question: What is included in website SEO services?
faqs.answer: Work can include technical checks for crawling and indexing, page titles and descriptions, heading structure, internal links, and content clarity. The exact scope depends on the site and its goals.

faqs.question: Can SEO guarantee a first-page ranking?
faqs.answer: No. No SEO provider can guarantee a specific search ranking. SEO improves a site's technical and content readiness, while results also depend on competition and search engine systems.

faqs.question: How do I request an SEO review?
faqs.answer: Send your website URL and the services or audience you want to reach on WhatsApp or email to request a free initial SEO check.

faqs.question: What does the free SEO check include?
faqs.answer: The initial check provides first observations about discoverability and page setup. Any deeper or ongoing SEO work can be discussed separately.

cta.description: Send your website URL on WhatsApp or email to request a free initial SEO check. You can also share which service or audience you want to reach.

contentSections.heading: Official fees and assistance prices are separate
paragraphs: The directory shows government charges separately from published provider price examples. Provider examples are not government fees or AshaRatna prices, and their scope may differ. Where no reliable public price could be verified, the directory says so instead of guessing.

AshaRatna's form-filling charge is confirmed by written quote before paid work begins. Government charges are paid through the relevant official channel. Fee information was checked on 8 October 2026 and can change, so confirm it on the linked government portal before paying.

contentSections.heading: Common central and Maharashtra services
paragraphs: Search across 35 commonly requested services, including identity documents, Maharashtra certificates, business registrations, tax forms, social-welfare schemes, education applications, and local permits. Government services and forms vary by state, district, eligibility, and notice. If a form is not listed, ask AshaRatna whether it can be supported.

contentSections.heading: Use authorised routes and protect personal information
paragraphs: AshaRatna Tech is an independent service provider, not a government office. Government departments decide eligibility, accept applications, and issue certificates or approvals. Aadhaar enrolment and biometrics must be completed at an authorised UIDAI centre. Udyam and e-Shram registration are free on their official portals; their official notices warn against registration charges.
Do not send Aadhaar or PAN images, OTPs, passwords, or bank credentials through ordinary WhatsApp or email. Use an official secure portal or authorised service centre for sensitive information.

faqs.question: Does AshaRatna Tech represent a government department?
faqs.answer: No. AshaRatna Tech is independent and does not make government eligibility or approval decisions. The linked official portals are the authority for applications and fees.

faqs.question: Are the published service prices AshaRatna's fees?
faqs.answer: No. Any third-party price example is identified as a provider example. AshaRatna confirms its own assistance fee in a written quote before paid work begins.

faqs.question: Does the directory include every government form in India?
faqs.answer: It covers 35 common central and Maharashtra services, not every central, state, district, municipal, or scheme-specific form. Contact AshaRatna about a service that is not listed.

faqs.question: How can I ask about one service?
faqs.answer: Use the WhatsApp or email action on that service card. Ask for the document checklist and a written assistance quote; do not include identity documents or OTPs in the first message.
